query:
WITH raw_input AS (
    SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
        $3::TEXT[], $4::TEXT[], $5::REAL[], $6::BIGINT[],
        $7::BIGINT[], $8::SMALLINT[], $9::TEXT[]
    ) AS value(book_id, cfi, progress, changed_at, client_seq, version_rank, event_id)
),
input AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (book_id) *
    FROM raw_input
    ORDER BY book_id, changed_at DESC, version_rank DESC, client_seq DESC, event_id COLLATE "C" DESC
)
INSERT INTO sync_reading_position_state(
    library_id, book_id, cfi, progress,
    changed_at, client_id, client_seq, version_rank, event_id
)
SELECT $1, book_id, cfi, progress, changed_at, $2, client_seq, version_rank, event_id
FROM input
ON CONFLICT (library_id, book_id) DO UPDATE SET
    cfi=EXCLUDED.cfi, progress=EXCLUDED.progress, changed_at=EXCLUDED.changed_at,
    client_id=EXCLUDED.client_id, client_seq=EXCLUDED.client_seq,
    version_rank=EXCLUDED.version_rank, event_id=EXCLUDED.event_id, server_seq=DEFAULT
WHERE (sync_reading_position_state.changed_at, sync_reading_position_state.version_rank, sync_reading_position_state.client_id COLLATE "C", sync_reading_position_state.client_seq, sync_reading_position_state.event_id COLLATE "C")
    < (EXCLUDED.changed_at, EXCLUDED.version_rank, EXCLUDED.client_id COLLATE "C", EXCLUDED.client_seq, EXCLUDED.event_id COLLATE "C");
